purpose: Development diagnostic only: compare the same complete originals under native lines, prior soft-hyphen assembly and explicit physical-hyphen wrap assembly. Preserve strict scores, every reference and unlocated spans. No repair, relaxed scoring or best-of selection.
normalization: Existing ASCII-whitespace collapse only, preserving NBSP, physical hyphens, punctuation, case and Unicode.
trace_policy: Unique exact prefix/suffix anchors followed by one bounded Levenshtein script; diagonal/deletion/insertion tie preference. Record visited ties without causal or uniqueness claims.
unlocated_policy: Keep missing, duplicate, short, reversed and budget-exceeded observations without guessing or selecting anchor occurrences.
